The '''Alderaanian Biological Research Institute''' was a research organization from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Liana Liberators]] posed as members of it when they came to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
